description.value: Rabbit Rabbit is a small wine bar and restaurant on the edge of Victoria's historic Chinatown, helmed by Executive Chef Billy Nguyen and Wine Director Sydney Cooper, with a frequently changing menu of locally sourced, seasonally driven cuisine. The wine program is curiosity-driven and focuses on small, sustainable producers from around the world, with notable representation from Vancouver Island wineries and appellations. The bar earned recognition in Air Canada's Best New Restaurants 2025 and has been nominated for the 2026 Vancouver Magazine Restaurant Awards.

No amenity details (bike parking, washrooms, wi-fi, takeout, etc.) are mentioned on the website, though the menu contains clearly vegetarian dishes by name.
